plan_metadata.title: Exact Non-Contiguous Citation Guidance and Regression Proof

focused_test_result.scope: Evidence extraction, provider runtime, and take-home-v4 case behaviour

CB-2025-0002.failure_summary: The model repeated a single synthesized quotation by concatenating separate structured image-text observations; no FactResolutionResult was admitted.
CB-2025-0002.next_design_boundary: A separately reviewed citation-ID or enumerated-span contract is required if prompt-only compliance is insufficient.

confirmed_diagnostics.rejected_supporting_text: Single Origin Ethiopia Yirgacheffe 250g, House Espresso Blend 1kg
confirmed_diagnostics.root_cause: The model combined two separately occurring passages and inserted punctuation that does not occur in the canonical page text.
The model concatenated separate structured written-text observations into one quotation instead of returning separate exact references.

objective.primary: Make the provider-facing contract explicitly require one contiguous canonical passage per TEXT reference and require multiple references when one fact value depends on separate passages.
success_path: Provider extracts one policy-requested fact value
Provider supplies one exact TEXT reference per contiguous passage
Multiple non-contiguous passages remain separate references
Existing exact deterministic citation validation succeeds
Existing immutable fact admission and deterministic downstream pipeline continue unchanged

included: Strengthen the shared provider-neutral extraction instructions.
Strengthen the provider-facing supporting_text JSON Schema description.
Add examples for one value supported by two non-contiguous TEXT references.
Bump the shared fact-extraction prompt version consistently for Nebius, OpenAI, and Anthropic.
Add focused unit, provider-contract, and Case 0005/0002 regression tests.
Run an isolated live Nebius qualification only after separate approval.
excluded: Automatically splitting or repairing invalid provider quotations.
Changing policy facts, predicates, evaluations, recommendations, or analyst UI behaviour.
Changing the image observation channels or weakening visual limitations.
Provider fallback, retries across providers, or model substitution.
Rewriting historical EvidenceDocuments, FactResolutionResults, or review packages.

non_negotiable_invariants: supporting_text must remain a verbatim substring of the referenced canonical page after only the existing shared Unicode and whitespace normalization.
One TEXT reference may identify only one contiguous source passage.
A model must not join separate lines, list items, table cells, or observations by inserting commas, conjunctions, labels, or other punctuation.
When one fact value depends on multiple non-contiguous passages, the value must contain multiple TEXT references in source order.
Each separate reference must independently pass the existing document, page, extraction-method, and exact-text validation.
The raw fact value may summarize the supported concept, but its provenance quotations may not be synthesized.
Any invalid reference rejects the complete candidate response and produces no FactResolutionResult.
Missing evidence remains NOT_FOUND and never becomes evidence of the opposite.
All providers encounter the same canonical schema and deterministic admission boundary.
Credentials and raw evidence content remain absent from normal logs and persisted errors.

instruction_additions: Define supporting_text as exactly one contiguous substring copied from canonical_text.
Explicitly prohibit concatenating separate passages even when they appear on the same page.
Explicitly prohibit inserting commas, semicolons, conjunctions, labels, or ellipses between source passages.
Require a separate TEXT reference for each non-contiguous supporting passage.
Explain that multiple references may support one resolved value.
Include the Case 0005 pattern as a generic shape-only example without case IDs or production special-casing.

valid_shape_example.raw_value: Single Origin Ethiopia Yirgacheffe 250g; House Espresso Blend 1kg

invalid_shape_example.supporting_text: Single Origin Ethiopia Yirgacheffe 250g, House Espresso Blend 1kg
invalid_shape_example.reason: This inserts a comma and combines two separately occurring passages.

provider_facing_contract_change.schema_description: Verbatim, contiguous substring copied exclusively from one referenced page's canonical_text. Never combine separate passages or add punctuation. Use multiple references for non-contiguous support.

prompt_version_change.reason: Execution lineage and cache identity must show that the provider received materially stronger citation instructions.

file_change_plan.change: Add the contiguous-passage rule, non-contiguous multi-reference rule, prohibited concatenation language, and valid/invalid shape examples to the shared instructions.
Strengthen the supporting_text field description so all provider-generated JSON Schemas carry the same contiguous-source rule.
Bump only the recorded fact-extraction prompt version; do not alter transport or parsing.
Bump the same fact-extraction prompt version; preserve native OpenAI transport.
Bump the same fact-extraction prompt version; preserve native Anthropic transport.
Assert the shared instructions and schema description contain the contiguous-passage and multiple-reference rules.
Add provider-neutral admission tests proving two exact references are accepted while one synthesized combined quotation is rejected with the existing diagnostic.
Assert all three provider identities record prompt version 0.6.0 without changing adapters or parameters.
Add or extend fixture-backed Case 0005 and Case 0002 regression coverage without case-ID-specific production logic.

implementation_sequence.name: Safe checkpoint
tasks: Record branch, HEAD, and worktree state.
Preserve all modified and untracked live databases.
Run the ordinary suite and stop if it is not green.
Record protected baseline database checksums.

implementation_sequence.name: Provider-neutral contract clarification
tasks: Update shared extraction instructions.
Update supporting_text schema description.
Add valid and invalid non-contiguous citation examples.
Bump the shared fact prompt version across all three adapters.

implementation_sequence.name: Deterministic regression tests
tasks: Prove separate exact references for one value are admitted.
Prove a synthesized combined quotation is rejected.
Prove no automatic splitting, repair, or punctuation tolerance occurs.
Prove provider adapters retain their existing transport and canonical response shape.
Prove Case 0005 and Case 0002 fixtures retain exact provenance.

implementation_sequence.name: Offline regression checkpoint
tasks: Run focused extraction and provider-contract tests.
Run the complete ordinary test suite.
Confirm historical database hashes remain unchanged.

implementation_sequence.name: Optional live qualification
implementation_sequence.authorization: Requires separate explicit approval because it transmits evidence and may incur provider cost.
tasks: Use a new isolated database.
Run CB-2025-0005 with the configured Nebius model.
Run CB-2025-0002 with the configured Nebius model.
Confirm successful citations use separate exact references for non-contiguous passages.
If the provider still violates the contract, retain fail-closed behaviour and report the exact bounded diagnostic rather than weakening validation.

prompt_and_schema: The prompt states that supporting_text is one contiguous canonical substring.
The prompt prohibits inserted punctuation and joined passages.
The prompt demonstrates multiple references supporting one value.
The generated provider schema exposes the same rule in the supporting_text description.
admission: Two exact same-page TEXT references supporting one value are accepted in source order.
Two exact cross-page references supporting one value are accepted when both pages belong to admitted documents.
A comma-joined quotation that does not occur canonically is rejected.
A punctuation-corrected or paraphrased quotation is rejected.
One invalid reference among several rejects the complete candidate response.
No failed candidate creates a FactResolutionResult.
provider_parity: Nebius, OpenAI, and Anthropic receive the revised shared instructions.
All three expose the same canonical reference schema.
Nebius remains Chat Completions, OpenAI remains Responses, and Anthropic remains Messages.
No fallback, retry, or provider substitution is added.
case_regression: Case 0005 represents its two invoice line items with separately grounded references.
Case 0002 represents a multi-line delivery address with separately grounded references when the canonical representation contains separate observations.
Case 0006 preserves its written-text, visible-pixel, and limitation boundaries.

acceptance_criteria: The exact citation validator and normalization implementation are unchanged.
The provider contract explicitly distinguishes one fact value from one or more supporting source passages.
Non-contiguous evidence is represented by multiple exact references, never a synthesized quotation.
The Case 0005 comma-joined failure is covered by a deterministic regression test.
The Case 0002 structured-image citation pattern is covered by a deterministic regression test.
Historical policies, databases, results, recommendations, and review packages remain unchanged.
Any live provider violation continues to fail closed with no partial admission.

risks_and_controls.risk: A live model may ignore the clarified instructions.
risks_and_controls.control: Keep deterministic rejection unchanged. Do not repair output. Report the precise error and consider a separately reviewed citation-ID design only if live qualification remains unreliable.

risks_and_controls.risk: Changing the shared prompt could alter outputs from all providers.
risks_and_controls.control: Limit the change to provenance formatting, bump the prompt version, run shared contract tests, and preserve every downstream validator.

risks_and_controls.risk: Multiple references could be misused to hide conflicting values.
risks_and_controls.control: Retain existing fact cardinality, distinct-value, status, and provenance validation; references support one value but do not merge distinct values.

risks_and_controls.risk: Existing successful resolutions could be recomputed under the new prompt.
risks_and_controls.control: Keep immutable persisted results idempotent. Only unresolved selections or new runs invoke the revised prompt.

rollback_plan.code: Revert the shared prompt/schema-description changes and prompt-version bump as one isolated commit.
rollback_plan.data: No migration rollback is required; live qualification uses a new disposable database.
rollback_plan.behaviour: The existing strict validator remains in place before, during, and after rollback.

approval_gates.authorizes: P4 only after the offline suite passes.
